q.q: Which sorting algorithm runs in O(n) best-case time when the input is already nearly sorted?
q.x: Insertion sort is adaptive: best case (already sorted) is O(n). Merge and heap sort are always O(n log n).

q.q: What is the worst-case time complexity of Quick sort?
q.x: Quick sort is O(n log n) on average but degrades to O(n^2) in the worst case (e.g. already sorted input with a poor pivot).

q.q: Which sorting algorithm has O(n log n) worst-case time complexity?
q.x: Merge sort guarantees O(n log n). Insertion, bubble and selection sorts are O(n^2) in the worst case.
